defects: Does not formalize total variation (eVariationOn) at all — the conclusion is a trivial identity between two ways of writing the same sum (|f(x(i+1)) - f(x i)| vs dist(f(x(i+1)), f(x i))), which holds by definition on ℝ regardless of monotonicity, so the core mathematical content of the theorem is missing
The monotonicity hypothesis hx is vacuous/unused for the stated conclusion, since the claimed equality holds for any x, not just monotone sequences
Restricts domain type from a general LinearOrder α to ℝ specifically
Restricts codomain from a general PseudoEMetricSpace E to ℝ with the standard metric, losing generality
Uses n directly as range n rather than the gold's u '' Iic n / range n (off-by-one indexing structure not carefully matched to the image of Iic n)
Fails to capture that variation is taken over the image set u '' Iic n (a set of size up to n+1 with possible repeats due to non-strict monotonicity) — instead just sums over index range n directly
